Afonso Henriques]]. The club also stands out on the national and international scene in other sports such as [[volleyball]], [[basketball]], [[handball]], [[water polo]], [[Swimming (sport)|swimming]], [[jiu-jitsu]], [[taekwondo]], [[kickboxing]], [[chess]] and [[Sport of athletics|athletics]], among others.{{Cite web |date=2021-07-06 |title=Modalidades - Vitória Sport Clube |url=https://vitoriasc.pt/modalidades/ |access-date=2025-02-03 |language=pt-PT}} It is currently the club with the fourth highest number of seasons at the top level of Portuguese football, totalling 81, and also the club with the fourth highest [[List of sports clubs by membership|number of members]], around 39,000.{{Cite web |title=Dia de eleições: quase 12.800 sócios decidem o futuro do V. Guimarães este sábado |url=https://www.record.pt/futebol/futebol-nacional/liga-betclic/v--guimaraes/detalhe/dia-de-eleicoes-quase-12800-socios-decidem-o-futuro-do-v-guimaraes-este-sabado |access-date=2025-06-03 |website=www.record.pt |language=pt-PT}} It also has the fourth best average stadium attendance in Portugal, well ahead of its direct rivals.{{Cite web |date=2017-05-05 |title=Adeptos fazem do V. Guimarães o quarto grande de Portugal |url=https://www.noticiasaominuto.com/desporto/788028/adeptos-fazem-do-v-guimaraes-o-quarto-grande-de-portugal |access-date=2025-05-11 |website=Notícias ao Minuto |language=pt}} Vitória Guimarães have finished third in the [[Primeira Liga]] on four occasions, most recently in [[2007–08 Primeira Liga|2007–08]]. They have won one [[Taça de Portugal]] in [[2013 Taça de Portugal Final|2012–13]], one [[Taça da Liga]] in [[2026 Taça da Liga final|2025–26]] and one [[Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira]] in [[1988 Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira|1988]], while also being runners-up of the former on six occasions. These three different achievements mean that Vitória SC is now the fourth Portuguese club to have won all the national cups, something only matched by the [[Big Three (Portugal)|big three]].{{Cite web |date=2026-01-11 |title=Só V. Guimarães ao nível dos três grandes |url=https://sapo.pt/artigo/so-v-guimaraes-ao-nivel-dos-tres-grandes-6963dcc7ab728f90f0d44f19 |access-date=2026-01-12 |website=SAPO |language=pt}}{{Cite web |date=2026-01-11 |title=Vitória SC faz história e junta todas as taças nacionais |work=Golo FM |url=https://golo.fm/vitoria-sc/vitoria-sc-faz-historia-e-junta-todas-as-tacas-nacionais/ |access-date=2026-01-12 |language=pt-PT}} The club have competed regularly in European competitions, where their best finish was the quarter-finals of the [[1986–87 UEFA Cup]]. Vitória SC have a long-standing rivalry with nearby club [[S.C. Braga|SC Braga]], with whom they contest the [[Derby do Minho]]. In addition to this age-old rivalry, Vitória has another major dispute with [[Boavista F.C.|Boavista]] from the city of Porto."}}
